_doc: Single source of truth for the tcg-art agent orchestration. Switching the Vercel account/scope/project, the board, or the repo later = edit this file only; the scripts read from here.

board._doc: GitHub Projects board the watcher polls and the agent writes. ids from `gh project` / field-create.

vercel._doc: SWAP THIS BLOCK to move to a different Vercel account/scope/project (e.g. a future j0ntz-owned Vercel). scope = the team/account slug from the dashboard URL. bypassSecret = Vercel Protection Bypass for Automation token (set once deployment protection is configured; empty disables the protected-preview drive).
